LS03.P1.planning_status: Implemented current whole unit; actual author clean execution and one different peer required. No physical/fork/Store claim.
LS03.P1.statement:
The default deployment SHALL use a scheduled GitHub Actions updater and public
GitHub Pages files for one family's watch, without an always-running backend,
AWS account, domain purchase or recurring LLM calls. Watches MUST NOT query the
provider directly by default. Public feed files MUST contain launch/catalog data
only; fitness values and personal identifiers SHALL remain on the watch.

LS03.P12.oracle: Actual captured current launch through producer and durable local Git; real loopback complete readback, missing/corrupt immutable,503root and root-switch counterexamples; exact diagnostic dictionaries and unchanged state/age/quota.
LS03.P12.planning_status: Implemented current whole unit; actual author clean execution and one different peer required. No physical/fork/Store claim.
LS03.P12.statement: Current-generation exact readback fails closed and diagnoses each closure mismatch with bounded path, mutable-root/immutable-file kind, phase, status, expected/actual byte counts and SHA256 without response bodies, credentials or endpoint URLs. The sole mutable root is reread after complete immutable closure. Observation never changes accepted/pending bytes, source/state ages or quota.

LS03.P3.oracle: Real loopback9115-byte404 versus8193-byte200/truncation/redirect; independently walked current JSON/SVG pins and exact sparse CLI files; fresh re-pinned unapproved rights rejected by actual catalog owner.
LS03.P3.planning_status: Implemented current whole unit; actual author clean execution and one different peer required. No physical/fork/Store claim.
LS03.P3.statement: HTTP404 error bodies never consume the successful8192byte feed admission budget; a single data-only recipe supplies the exact sparse tracked current producer/input closure, including source rights/digests and corrupt-input refusal without overwrite. The producer uses its pinned native renderer; no stdlib-only/full-product assertion.

LS16.P1.oracle: Retain exact unchanged-source6Node observations (real ten-second loopback cancellation and redirect sink included); verify original TAP hashes/identities. Root-owned encrypted-secret/config/natural-event history plus current G1/G2 due/publicreadback; evidence-only negative controls refuse dispatch-only/not-due/incomplete/one-event/plain-secret claims. No new hosted invocation or future-availability claim.
LS16.P1.planning_status: Implemented current whole unit; actual author clean execution and one different peer required. No physical/fork/Store claim.
LS16.P1.statement: An independent stateless scheduled handler admits only the configured cron with a secret, sends one fixed main dispatch with a real ten-second cancellation bound and no retry/redirect/secret disclosure, and leaves overlapping publisher events to the existing downstream authority; live automatic delivery requires actual clock/run/due-feed/readback qualification.
